subject: Math
prompt:
An angle has a measure of $\frac{(14\pi )}{(15)}$ radians. What is the measure of the angle, in degrees?

$$0$$

$$168$$
explanation: The correct answer is $168$. The measure of an angle, in degrees, can be found by multiplying its measure, in radians, by $\frac{180 \text{ degrees}}{\pi \text{ radians}}$. Multiplying $\frac{14\pi}{15}$ radians by $\frac{180 \text{ degrees}}{\pi \text{ radians}}$ yields $\frac{14 \cdot 180}{15} = 168$ degrees.
